meta.name: trojan_horse_troy
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

programs.brief: A colossal wooden effigy of a horse built on heavy timber rolling beams from rough-hewn oak and fir planks (api.theme.wood). It has a hollow belly chamber with an internal ladder and a concealed bottom trapdoor holding elite Greek warriors awaiting nightfall.
An abandoned Achaean siege position with weathered tent frames, spear racks, dirt earthworks, and cold campfires left behind on the coastal plain.

tokens.terrain: a fortified city on a rise above the coastal plain; Aegean shore in view in the distance
tokens.icons: colossal wooden horse standing inside the city walls near the main gate; monumental cyclopean walls and gate towers; deserted Greek beachhead camp across the plain; royal citadel megaron rising above dense flat-roofed quarters
tokens.event_direction: Achaean soldiers concealed inside the hollow wooden horse awaiting nightfall to open the gates
tokens.infra: processional cart_track from the beach plain through the Scaean gates into the central plaza
